camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeRCSnapshots --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testRC --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'example-string' --Tag.1.Value test01 --SnapshotIds 'rcds-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcds-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_…_rcds-bp67acfmxazb6p0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DiskId 'rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw0000'
description_en: This API is used to query snapshot list information, such as snapshot status, the remaining time for a snapshot being created to complete, and the number of days automatic snapshots are retained
description_zh: 该接口用于查询快照列表信息。例如快照状态、正在创建的快照剩余完成时间、自动快照保留天数等
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-rc-snapshots --disk-id rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw0000 --snapshot-ids 'rcds-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcds-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_…_rcds-bp67acfmxazb6p0000' --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=test01 Key=testRC --instance-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCSnapshots

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot IDs.

You can specify a maximum of 100 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
快照标识编码。

可以由多个快照ID组成，多个ID用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多支持100个ID
parameters.name: snapshot_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Available.description_en:
Indicates whether the snapshot can be shared and used to create or roll back a cloud disk. Valid values:

true
false
Available.description_zh:
快照是否可用于创建云盘、回滚云盘、共享快照。取值说明：
true：可用。
false：不可用

Category.description_en:
The snapshot type. Valid values:

Standard: standard snapshot
Flash: local snapshot This value will be deprecated. The local snapshot feature is replaced with the instant access feature.
archive: archived snapshot
Category.description_zh:
快照类型。取值说明：
Standard：标准快照。
Flash：本地快照。该参数取值即将被弃用，原本地快照更替为快照极速可用功能。
archive：归档快照

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Encrypted.description_en:
Indicates whether the snapshot was encrypted. Valid values:

true
false
Encrypted.description_zh:
该快照是否加密。取值说明：
true：加密。
false：不加密

InstantAccess.description_zh: 该参数已弃用，无需填写

LastModifiedTime.title_en: Last modification time of the snapshot. Represented in ISO 8601 standard using UTC+0 time, in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.
LastModifiedTime.title_zh: 快照的最后变更时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

Progress.description_en: The progress of the snapshot creation task in percentage
Progress.description_zh: 快照创建进度，单位为百分比

SnapshotType.description_en:
The snapshot type. Valid values:

auto or timer: automatically created snapshot
user: manually created snapshot
all: all snapshot types
SnapshotType.description_zh:
快照创建类型。取值说明：
auto或者timer：自动创建快照。
user：手动创建快照。
all：所有的快照创建类型

SourceDiskId.description_en: The ID of the original disk. This parameter is retained even after the original disk for which the snapshot was created is released
SourceDiskId.description_zh: 源云盘ID。如果快照的源云盘已经被释放，该字段仍旧保留

SourceDiskSize.description_en: The storage capacity of the original disk. Unit: GiB

SourceDiskType.description_en:
The type of the original disk. Valid values:

SYSTEM: system disk
DATA: data disk
SourceDiskType.description_zh:
源磁盘类型。取值说明：
SYSTEM：系统盘。
DATA：数据盘

SourceStorageType.description_en:
The type of the source disk.

This parameter will be removed in the future. To ensure future compatibility, we recommend that you use other parameters
SourceStorageType.description_zh:
源云盘类型。

该参数即将被弃用，为提高兼容性，建议您尽量使用其他参数

Status.description_en:
The snapshot status. Valid values:

progressing: The snapshot is being created.
accomplished: The snapshot is created.
failed: The snapshot fails to be created
Status.description_zh:
快照状态。取值说明
progressing：正在创建的快照
accomplished：创建成功的快照
failed：创建失败的快照

Usage.description_en:
Indicates whether the snapshot is used to create custom images or disks. Valid values:

image: The snapshot is used to create custom images.
disk: The snapshot is used to create disks.
image_disk: The snapshot is used to create custom images and data disks.
none: The snapshot is not used to create custom images or disks
Usage.description_zh:
快照是否被用作创建镜像或云盘。取值说明：
image：使用快照创建了自定义镜像。
disk：使用快照创建了云盘。
image_disk：使用快照创建了数据盘和自定义镜像。
none：暂未使用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
